title: How To and How Not To Approach This Course

cues.en: Now you might be asking, how should I approach this course?
cues.zh: 你現在可能在想，該怎麼學習這門課？

cues.en: You might not be asking, but we're going to answer it anyway.
cues.zh: 也可能沒在想，但我們還是要回答。

cues.en: How to approach this course.
cues.zh: 如何學習這門課？

cues.en: This is how I would recommend approaching this course.
cues.zh: 我建議這樣做。

cues.en: So I'm a machine learning engineer day to day and learning machine learning to coding, machine learning a kind of two different things.
cues.zh: 我每天的工作是機器學習工程師，學習機器學習，和寫機器學習程式，其實有點不同。

cues.en: I remember when I first learned it was kind of you learned a lot of theory rather than writing code.
cues.zh: 記得剛開始學時，學了很多理論，卻不太寫程式，

cues.en: So what to take away from the theory of being important?
cues.zh: 這不是要否定理論的重要性，

cues.en: This course is going to be focusing on writing machine learning, specifically PyTorch code.
cues.zh: 但這門課會著重撰寫機器學習，具體來說是 PyTorch 程式碼。

cues.en: So the number one step to approaching this course is to code along.
cues.zh: 所以學這門課的第一步，是跟著寫程式。

cues.en: Now, because this course is focused on purely writing code, I will be linking extracurricular resources for you to learn more about what's going on behind the scenes of the code.
cues.zh: 因為這門課純粹著重寫程式，我會提供課外補充資源，讓你更了解程式碼背後發生什麼。

cues.en: My idea of teaching is that if we can code together, write some code, see how it's working, that's going to spark your curiosity to figure out what's going on behind the scenes.
cues.zh: 我的教學想法是，如果一起寫程式，看看怎麼運作，就會激發你的好奇心，想了解背後發生什麼。

cues.en: So motto number one is, if in doubt, run the code, write it, run the code, See what happens.
cues.zh: 所以第一個口訣：有疑問，就執行程式碼。寫下來、執行，看看會怎樣。

cues.en: Number two.
cues.zh: 第二，

cues.en: Oh, I love that.
cues.zh: 喔，我喜歡這個，

cues.en: Explore and experiment again.
cues.zh: 探索與實驗。同樣地，

cues.en: Approach this with the idea, the mind of a scientist and a chef or science and art.
cues.zh: 抱著科學家與廚師的想法，也就是科學與藝術的心態，

cues.en: Experiment, experiment, experiment.
cues.zh: 實驗、實驗、再實驗。

cues.en: Try things with wriggle like a scientist would, and then just try things for the fun of it like a chef would.
cues.zh: 像科學家一樣嚴謹試驗，也像廚師一樣，為了好玩而嘗試。

cues.en: Number three, visualize what you don't understand.
cues.zh: 第三，把不懂的東西視覺化。

cues.en: I can't emphasize this one enough.
cues.zh: 這點再強調都不為過。

cues.en: We have three models so far.
cues.zh: 到目前有三個口訣，

cues.en: If in doubt, run the code.
cues.zh: 有疑問，就執行程式碼，

cues.en: You're going to hear me say this a lot.
cues.zh: 你會經常聽到我這樣說；

cues.en: Experiment, experiment, experiment.
cues.zh: 實驗、實驗、再實驗；

cues.en: And number three, Visualize, visualize, visualize.
cues.zh: 第三，視覺化、視覺化、再視覺化。

cues.en: Why is this?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: Well, because we've spoken about machine learning and deep learning deals with a lot of data, a lot of numbers.
cues.zh: 因為談過，機器學習與深度學習會處理大量資料、大量數字。

cues.en: And so I find it that if I visualize some numbers in whatever form, that isn't just numbers all over a page, I tend to understand it better.
cues.zh: 我發現，如果用某種形式把數字視覺化，而不只是整頁滿滿的數字，就會更容易理解。

cues.en: And there are some great extra resources that I'm going to link that also turn what we're doing.
cues.zh: 我會連結一些很棒的額外資源，也會把我們做的事，

cues.en: So writing code into fantastic visualizations.
cues.zh: 也就是寫程式，轉成很棒的視覺化。

cues.en: Number four, ask questions, including the dumb questions.
cues.zh: 第四，提問，包括傻問題。

cues.en: Really, There's no such thing as a dumb question.
cues.zh: 真的沒有傻問題，

cues.en: Everyone is just on a different part of their learning journey.
cues.zh: 每個人只是在學習旅程的不同位置。

cues.en: And in fact, if you do have a quote unquote dumb question, it turns out that a lot of people probably have that one as well.
cues.zh: 其實如果有個所謂傻問題，很可能還有很多人也有同樣疑問。

cues.en: So be sure to ask questions.
cues.zh: 所以一定要提問，

cues.en: I'm going to link a resource in a minute of where you can ask those questions.
cues.zh: 等一下會提供可以提問的資源連結。

cues.en: But please, please, please ask questions not only to the community but to Google, to the Internet, to wherever you can or just yourself.
cues.zh: 不過，拜託，一定要問。不只向社群，也向 Google、網路、任何能問的地方，甚至自己提問。

cues.en: Ask questions of the code and write code to figure out the answer to those questions.
cues.zh: 對程式碼提出問題，再寫程式找出答案。

cues.en: Number five, do the exercises.
cues.zh: 第五，做練習。

cues.en: There are some great exercises that I've created for each of the modules.
cues.zh: 每個模組，我都設計了很棒的練習。

cues.en: If we go, have we got the book version of the course up here?
cues.zh: 看看，這裡有書籍版課程嗎？

cues.en: We do.
cues.zh: 有。

cues.en: Within all of these chapters here, down the bottom is going to be exercises and extra curriculum.
cues.zh: 這些章節最下面，都會有練習與課外補充。

cues.en: So we've got some exercises.
cues.zh: 所以有一些練習，

cues.en: I'm not going to jump into them, but I would highly recommend don't just follow along with the course and code.
cues.zh: 我先不點進去，但很建議你不要只跟著課程寫程式，

cues.en: After I code, please, please, please give the exercises a go because that's going to stretch your knowledge.
cues.zh: 我寫完之後，請一定自己做練習，因為那能拓展你的知識。

cues.en: We're going to have a lot of practice writing code together, doing all of this stuff here.
cues.zh: 我們會有很多機會一起寫程式，做這些事情，

cues.en: But then the exercises are going to give you a chance to practice what you've learned and then, of course, extra curriculum.
cues.zh: 但練習會讓你有機會應用所學；當然也有課外補充，

cues.en: Well, hey, if you want to learn more, there's plenty of opportunities to do so there.
cues.zh: 如果想學更多，那裡有很多機會。

cues.en: And then finally, number six, share your work.
cues.zh: 最後第六，分享你的成果。

cues.en: I can't emphasize enough how much writing about learning deep learning or sharing my work through GitHub
cues.zh: 撰寫深度學習的學習心得，或透過 GitHub、

cues.en: or different code resources or with the community has helped with my learning.
cues.zh: 不同程式資源、社群分享成果，對我的學習幫助有多大，再強調都不為過。

cues.en: So if you learn something cool about PyTorch, I'd love to see it, link it to me somehow in the Discord Chat or on GitHub or whatever.
cues.zh: 如果學到關於 PyTorch 很酷的東西，我很想看。可以在 Discord、GitHub 或其他地方，把連結給我，

cues.en: There'll be links of where you can find me.
cues.zh: 我會提供找到我的連結。

cues.en: I'd love to see it.
cues.zh: 我很想看看，

cues.en: Please do share your work.
cues.zh: 請務必分享成果。

cues.en: It's a great way to not only learn something because when you share it, when you write about it, it's like, how would someone else understand it?
cues.zh: 這不只是很好的學習方式，因為分享、寫下來時，會想別人該怎麼理解，

cues.en: But it's also a great way to help others learn too.
cues.zh: 也是幫助別人學習的好方式。

cues.en: And so.
cues.zh: 所以，

cues.en: We said how to approach this course.
cues.zh: 剛才說了如何學這門課，

cues.en: Now let's go how not to approach this course.
cues.zh: 現在來說不該怎麼學。

cues.en: I would love for you to avoid overthinking the process.
cues.zh: 希望你避免把過程想得太複雜。

cues.en: And this is your brain and this is your brain on fire.
cues.zh: 這是你的大腦，這是大腦著火，

cues.en: So avoid having your brain on fire.
cues.zh: 所以避免讓大腦著火，

cues.en: That's not a good place to be.
cues.zh: 那不是好的狀態。

cues.en: We are working with PyTorch, so it's going to be quite hot just playing on words with the name torch.
cues.zh: 我們使用 PyTorch，當然會很熱，只是用 torch 名稱玩個文字遊戲，

cues.en: But avoid your brain catching on fire and avoid saying I can't learn.
cues.zh: 但別讓大腦著火，也別說「我學不會，

cues.en: Da da da da da da.
cues.zh: 這個、那個等等」。

cues.en: I've said this to myself lots of times and then I've practiced it and it turns out I can actually learn those things.
cues.zh: 我也常對自己這樣說，但練習之後，發現其實能學會。

cues.en: So let's just draw a red line on that.
cues.zh: 所以用紅線劃掉，

cues.en: Oh, I think a red line.
cues.zh: 喔，我想紅線，

cues.en: Yeah.
cues.zh: 對，

cues.en: There we go.
cues.zh: 有了，

cues.en: Nice and thick red line.
cues.zh: 又粗又漂亮的紅線，

cues.en: We'll get that out there.
cues.zh: 把它劃掉。

cues.en: It doesn't really make sense now that this has a void and crossed out.
cues.zh: 現在寫了 avoid，又劃掉，好像不太合理，

cues.en: But don't say I can't learn and prevent your brain from catching on fire.
cues.zh: 但不要說學不會，也別讓大腦著火。

cues.en: Finally, we've got one more video that I'm going to cover before this one gets too long of the resources for the course before we get into coding.
cues.zh: 最後，在開始寫程式之前，還有一支介紹課程資源的影片，避免這支太長。

cues.en: I'll see you there.
cues.zh: 到時見。
